standard_prerequisites: Classical orthogonal polynomials on the unit circle and their Riemann–Hilbert representation
Liouville theorem and the existing Cresswell–Joshi discrete hierarchy
core_obligations: Granting the classical OPUC Riemann–Hilbert correspondence, Liouville arguments and the known Cresswell–Joshi hierarchy as priors does not supply the Toeplitz-to-hierarchy recurrence. The author constructs the jump-normalized wave function and a spectral/shift Lax pair, exploits inversion symmetry to reduce an overdetermined compatibility system, and derives coupled coefficient recursions with discrete antiderivatives and the original integration constants. Strong-induction polynomiality and index-reversal relations then turn the matrix recursion into the scalar N-fold operator and close the Toeplitz determinant identity. This full construction is one H2 result; the terminal substitution, norm ratio, elementary symmetry/compatibility lemmas and low-order examples are not separate hard problems.
proof_roadmap: Retain the full original author analytic/algebraic construction through scalar recursion and the Toeplitz relation; one unit for the whole principal result.
